source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י ע֚וֹד לֵ֣ךְ אֱֽהַב־אִשָּׁ֔ה אֲהֻ֥בַת רֵ֖עַ וּמְנָאָ֑פֶת כְּאַהֲבַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְהֵ֗ם פֹּנִים֙ אֶל־אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְאֹהֲבֵ֖י אֲשִׁישֵׁ֥י עֲנָבִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Yahweh to me, Again go, love a woman loved of a companion and committing adultery, like [the] love of Yahweh [for] the sons of Israel, and they [are] turning to gods other and loving cakes of raisins.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to me, "Again go, love a woman loved by a companion and committing adultery, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} loves the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel, while they are turning to other gods and loving cakes of raisins."
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to me, "Go again, love a woman who is loved by another man and is an adulteress, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} loves the people of Israel, though they turn to other gods and love raisin cakes."
en.R: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to me, "Go again and love a woman who has another lover and is unfaithful to her husband. Love her the way {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} loves the people of Israel, even though they turn to other gods and love the raisin cakes offered to them."

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dijo: «Ve otra vez, ama a una mujer amada por un compañero y que comete adulterio, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ama a los hijos de Israel, mientras ellos se vuelven a otros dioses y aman las tortas de pasas».
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dijo: «Ve otra vez y ama a una mujer que es amada por otro hombre y que es adúltera, así como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ama a los israelitas, aunque ellos se vuelven a otros dioses y aman las tortas de pasas».
es.R: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dijo: «Ve otra vez y ama a una mujer que tiene otro amante y que le es infiel a su marido. Ámala como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ama al pueblo de Israel, aunque ellos se vuelven a otros dioses y les encantan las tortas de pasas que se les ofrecen».

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} me dit : « Va encore, aime une femme aimée d’un compagnon et adultère, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} aime les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël, alors qu’ils se tournent vers d’autres dieux et aiment les gâteaux de raisins. »
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} me dit : « Va encore, aime une femme qui est aimée d’un autre et qui commet l’adultère, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} aime les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}, bien qu’ils se tournent vers d’autres dieux et aiment les gâteaux de raisins. »
fr.R: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a dit : « Va encore une fois, et aime une femme qui a un autre amant et qui trompe son mari. Aime-la comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} aime les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}, même s’ils se tournent vers d’autres dieux et aiment les gâteaux de raisins qu’on leur offre. »

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 말씀하셨다. "다시 가서, 친구의 사랑을 받으면서 간음하는 여자를 사랑하여라. 이스라엘 자손이 다른 신들에게로 돌아서서 건포도 과자를 사랑하는데도 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 그들을 사랑하는 것처럼 [하여라]."
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 말씀하셨다. "다시 가서, 다른 남자의 사랑을 받으며 간음하는 여자를 사랑하여라. 이스라엘 백성이 다른 신들에게 돌아서서 건포도 과자를 좋아하는데도 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 그들을 사랑하는 것과 같이 하여라."
ko.R: 그때 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 말씀하셨다. "다시 가서 한 여자를 사랑하여라. 그 여자는 다른 애인이 있고, 남편에게 신실하지 않은 여자다. 이스라엘 백성은 다른 신들에게 돌아서서 그 신들에게 바친 건포도 과자를 좋아한다. 그런데도 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 그들을 사랑한다. 너도 그렇게 그 여자를 사랑하여라."

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với tôi: "Hãy đi nữa, hãy yêu một người đàn bà được một người bạn yêu và đang ngoại tình, như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} yêu con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên, dù chúng quay sang các thần khác và ưa thích bánh nho khô."
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với tôi: "Con hãy đi lần nữa, hãy yêu một người đàn bà đang được một người đàn ông khác yêu và đang phạm tội ngoại tình, như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} yêu dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, dù chúng quay sang các thần khác và ưa thích bánh nho khô."
vi.R: Rồi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với tôi: "Con hãy đi lần nữa và yêu một người đàn bà có tình nhân và không chung thủy với chồng. Hãy yêu nàng như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} yêu dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, dù chúng quay sang các thần khác và ưa thích những bánh nho khô dâng cho các thần ấy."

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaniambia, "Nenda tena, umpende mwanamke anayependwa na mwenzake, naye anazini, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anavyowapenda wana wa Israeli, nao wanageukia miungu mingine na kupenda maandazi ya zabibu kavu."
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliniambia, "Nenda tena, umpende mwanamke anayependwa na mwanamume mwingine, naye ni mzinzi, kama vile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anavyowapenda watu wa Israeli, ingawa wanageukia miungu mingine na kupenda maandazi ya zabibu kavu."
sw.R: Kisha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaniambia, "Nenda tena, umpende mwanamke ambaye ana mpenzi mwingine na si mwaminifu kwa mume wake. Mpende kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anavyowapenda watu wa Israeli, ingawa wanageukia miungu mingine na kupenda maandazi ya zabibu kavu yanayotolewa kwa miungu hiyo."

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me disse: "Vai outra vez, ama uma mulher amada por um companheiro e que comete adultério, como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} ama os filhos de Israel, enquanto eles se voltam para outros deuses e amam bolos de passas."
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} me disse: "Vai outra vez e ama uma mulher que é amada por outro homem e é adúltera, assim como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} ama os israelitas, embora eles se voltem para outros deuses e amem bolos de passas."
pt.R: Então {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me disse: "Vai outra vez e ama uma mulher que tem outro amante e é infiel ao marido. Ama essa mulher do jeito que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} ama o povo de Israel, mesmo que eles se voltem para outros deuses e gostem dos bolos de passas oferecidos a esses deuses."

decisions.choice: a woman: most likely Gomer, though the text does not name her
alternatives: the marriage of chapter 1, told again by Hosea
decisions.reason: The chapter is told by Hosea himself ("to me"). The woman is not named. Most readers take her to be Gomer: "again" points back to chapter 1, and the picture requires the LORD to love the same people who have been unfaithful to him, so Hosea must love the wife who has been unfaithful to him. Others take her to be a second woman, or read chapter 3 as Hosea's own account of the marriage in chapter 1. The text leaves the woman unnamed.

decisions.choice: loved by a companion: loved by another man; possibly by her husband
decisions.reason: The word means a friend, a companion or a neighbor, and in Jeremiah 3:20 it is used of a husband. "Loved by another man" fits the words that follow, "and committing adultery". Some read "loved by her husband", which would make the point that she is loved by Hosea and yet unfaithful. The reading "another man" is taken here.

decisions.choice: again: the LORD speaks again, and Hosea is to go again
decisions.reason: "Again" stands between "said to me" and "go" and can belong to either: "the LORD said to me again" or "go again". Both point back to chapter 1. Placed with "go", it says that Hosea is to love again.

decisions.choice: raisin cakes: festival food, here tied to the worship of other gods
decisions.reason: Cakes of pressed raisins were a festival food; David gave them to the people when the ark came to Jerusalem (2 Samuel 6:19). Here they go with the worship of other gods, as offerings or as food eaten at their feasts. Compare the cakes baked for the queen of heaven in Jeremiah 7:18.

decisions.choice: as the LORD loves the people of Israel: Hosea's love is to mirror the LORD's
decisions.reason: The command is not only to take the woman back but to love her, as the LORD keeps loving a people who turn to other gods. The love comes first; the change in her comes later (3:3-5).

decisions.choice: has another lover (R); unfaithful to her husband (R); offered to them (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what "loved by a companion and committing adultery" means (m2) and that the raisin cakes belong to the worship of the other gods (m4). It does not say whose wife she is, which the text leaves open (m1).

decisions.choice: "los hijos de Israel" (L); "los israelitas" (B); "el pueblo de Israel" (R)
decisions.reason: As the terms note sets for these books; Spanish "hijos" already includes daughters, so there is no gender span.

decisions.choice: "tortas de pasas"
decisions.reason: Raisin cakes, a festival food; the plain Spanish name at every level, with Readable adding that they were offered to the gods, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: Hosea tells chapter 3 himself: passé simple at L and B ("le SEIGNEUR me dit", "je l'achetai"), passé composé at R ("le SEIGNEUR m'a dit")
decisions.reason: First-person narrative follows the narrative tenses, as the term sheet sets for Hosea 3 and the prophets' visions.

decisions.choice: God names himself in the third person without -시- ("{{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 그들을 사랑하는 것처럼")
decisions.reason: God never takes -시- in his own mouth, even when he speaks of himself by name.

decisions.choice: Hosea narrates as "tôi"
decisions.reason: Chapter 3 is told in the first person, so Hosea says "tôi" at every level; God still says "ngươi" to him at Literal and "con" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: "maandazi ya zabibu kavu" (raisin cakes)
decisions.reason: The word the published Swahili uses for David's gift of raisin cakes (2 Samuel 6:19; 1 Chronicles 16:3).

decisions.choice: ama, amada, ama, amam (L, B)
decisions.reason: The verb "love" is said four times in the Hebrew, of Hosea, the lover, the LORD and the people (m1), and Portuguese keeps "amar" each time at Literal and Balanced so that the comparison is heard; Readable says "gostem" for the people's love of raisin cakes, a plainer word for a liking.

source.text: וָאֶכְּרֶ֣הָ לִּ֔י בַּחֲמִשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר כָּ֑סֶף וְחֹ֥מֶר שְׂעֹרִ֖ים וְלֵ֥תֶךְ שְׂעֹרִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And I bought her for myself for fifteen silver and a homer of barley and a lethech of barley.

en.L: So I bought her for myself for fifteen [shekels of] silver and a homer of barley and a lethech of barley.
en.B: So I bought her for myself for {{units:about 6 ounces of silver|fifteen shekels of silver}} and {{units:about 9 bushels of barley|a homer and a lethech of barley}}.
en.R: So I paid {{units:about 6 ounces of silver|fifteen shekels of silver}} and {{units:about 9 bushels of barley|a homer and a lethech of barley}} to get her for myself.

es.L: Así que la compré para mí por quince [siclos de] plata y un homer de cebada y un létec de cebada.
es.B: Así que la compré para mí por {{units:unos 170 gramos de plata|quince siclos de plata}} y {{units:unos 330 litros de cebada|un homer y un létec de cebada}}.
es.R: Así que pagué {{units:unos 170 gramos de plata|quince siclos de plata}} y {{units:unos 330 litros de cebada|un homer y un létec de cebada}} para tenerla conmigo.

fr.L: Et je l’achetai pour moi quinze [sicles d’]argent et un homer d’orge et un léthek d’orge.
fr.B: Je l’achetai donc pour moi pour {{units:environ 170 grammes d’argent|quinze sicles d’argent}} et {{units:environ 330 litres d’orge|un homer et un léthek d’orge}}.
fr.R: J’ai donc payé {{units:environ 170 grammes d’argent|quinze sicles d’argent}} et {{units:environ 330 litres d’orge|un homer et un léthek d’orge}} pour l’avoir avec moi.

ko.L: 그래서 나는 은 열다섯 [세겔]과 보리 한 호멜과 보리 한 레덱으로 그 여자를 나를 위해 샀다.
ko.B: 그래서 나는 {{units:은 약 170그램|은 열다섯 세겔}}과 {{units:약 330리터의 보리로|보리 한 호멜과 한 레덱으로}} 그 여자를 사서 나에게로 데려왔다.
ko.R: 그래서 나는 {{units:은 약 170그램|은 열다섯 세겔}}과 {{units:약 330리터의 보리를|보리 한 호멜과 한 레덱을}} 값으로 치르고 그 여자를 나에게로 데려왔다.

vi.L: Vậy tôi mua nàng cho mình với mười lăm [siếc-lơ] bạc, một hô-me lúa mạch và một lê-thết lúa mạch.
vi.B: Vậy tôi mua nàng về cho mình với {{units:khoảng 170 g bạc|mười lăm siếc-lơ bạc}} và {{units:khoảng 330 lít lúa mạch|một hô-me và một lê-thết lúa mạch}}.
vi.R: Vậy tôi trả {{units:khoảng 170 g bạc|mười lăm siếc-lơ bạc}} và {{units:khoảng 330 lít lúa mạch|một hô-me và một lê-thết lúa mạch}} để chuộc nàng về cho mình.

sw.L: Basi nikamnunua kwa ajili yangu kwa [shekeli] kumi na tano za fedha na homeri moja ya shayiri na letheki moja ya shayiri.
sw.B: Basi nilimnunua kwa ajili yangu kwa {{units:karibu gramu 170 za fedha|shekeli kumi na tano za fedha}} na {{units:karibu lita 330 za shayiri|homeri moja na letheki moja ya shayiri}}.
sw.R: Basi nililipa {{units:karibu gramu 170 za fedha|shekeli kumi na tano za fedha}} na {{units:karibu lita 330 za shayiri|homeri moja na letheki moja ya shayiri}} ili nimpate awe wangu.

pt.L: E eu a comprei para mim por quinze [siclos de] prata e um hômer de cevada e um leteque de cevada.
pt.B: Então eu a comprei para mim por {{units:cerca de 170 gramas de prata|quinze siclos de prata}} e {{units:cerca de 330 litros de cevada|um hômer e um leteque de cevada}}.
pt.R: Então paguei {{units:cerca de 170 gramas de prata|quinze siclos de prata}} e {{units:cerca de 330 litros de cevada|um hômer e um leteque de cevada}} para ficar com ela.

decisions.choice: bought her: acquired her by paying a price
decisions.reason: The verb is used for buying or bargaining (Deuteronomy 2:6). The verse does not say whom Hosea paid or why. She may have become someone's slave, or bound to another man, or the payment may be a bride-price for a new marriage. The price shows that bringing her back cost him something.

decisions.choice: fifteen shekels of silver, a homer and a lethech of barley: a price paid partly in silver, partly in grain
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "fifteen silver", meaning fifteen shekels; a shekel weighed about two-fifths of an ounce. A homer was about 6 bushels, the same measure used in Ezekiel 45:11. The lethech is named only here; it is usually taken as half a homer. Paying partly in barley, the cheapest grain, may suggest that Hosea did not have the whole sum in silver. The Greek translation reads "a measure of wine" instead of the lethech of barley.

decisions.choice: about 6 ounces of silver; about 9 bushels of barley (units setting)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew units and supplies "shekels of". Balanced and Readable give modern measures by default, with the original units as the alternative. The homer and lethech are given together, about 6 and 3 bushels, since the lethech is taken as half a homer (m2).

decisions.choice: So I paid ... to get her for myself
decisions.reason: Readable puts the price first and the purpose after, which reads more easily than "bought her for ...".

decisions.choice: "unos 170 gramos de plata"; "unos 330 litros de cebada" (units setting)
decisions.reason: Metric by default, as the Spanish elsewhere: fifteen shekels at about 11.4 g each, as the Ezekiel table (15 shekels, 170 g); a homer is 220 litres and a lethech half a homer, so about 330 litres. Literal keeps the original units; the alternative writes them out ("siclos", "homer", "létec").

decisions.choice: "environ 170 grammes d'argent" and "environ 330 litres d'orge" as the metric defaults, with "quinze sicles d'argent" and "un homer et un léthek d'orge" as the original
decisions.reason: French gives metric values, as the style guide asks: a shekel at about 11.5 g as the Pentateuch note, a homer at 220 litres and the lethech, half a homer, at 110 litres; the English converts the same amounts into US units.

decisions.choice: {{units:khoảng 170 g bạc|mười lăm siếc-lơ bạc}}; {{units:khoảng 330 lít lúa mạch|một hô-me và một lê-thết lúa mạch}}
decisions.reason: Vietnamese units spans are metric by default with the original unit as the alternative, as the style guide sets; the figures follow the terms note (shekel 11,5 g; homer 220 litres, lethech half a homer). Literal keeps the original units.

decisions.choice: "karibu gramu 170 za fedha"; "karibu lita 330 za shayiri" (units setting)
decisions.reason: Swahili gives metric values by default with the original units as the alternative, unlike the English ounces and bushels: a shekel about 11.5 grams, a homer about 220 litres and a lethech, half a homer, about 110 litres. Literal keeps the original units. "letheki" is new and follows the usual pattern for names of measures.

decisions.choice: "{{units:은 약 170그램|은 열다섯 세겔}}" and "{{units:약 330리터의 보리|보리 한 호멜과 한 레덱}}"
decisions.reason: Korean converts to metric, as in Kings and the other prophets; the English converts to ounces and bushels. A shekel is about 11.5 grams; a homer and a lethech (half a homer) about 330 litres. Literal keeps the original units.

decisions.choice: cerca de 170 gramas de prata; cerca de 330 litros de cevada (units setting)
decisions.reason: Metric by default, as the Old Testament terms give the shekel (11,5 g) and the homer (220 litros), with the lethech as half a homer; the Hebrew measures are the alternative, where the English gives US units. Literal keeps "siclos", "hômer" (as Ezekiel 45:11) and "leteque".

source.text: וָאֹמַ֣ר אֵלֶ֗יהָ יָמִ֤ים רַבִּים֙ תֵּ֣שְׁבִי לִ֔י לֹ֣א תִזְנִ֔י וְלֹ֥א תִֽהְיִ֖י לְאִ֑ישׁ וְגַם־אֲנִ֖י אֵלָֽיִךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And I said to her, Days many you will stay for me; not you will prostitute yourself, and not you will be for a man; and also I to you.

en.L: And I said to her, "Many days you will stay for me; you will not prostitute yourself, and you will not be for a man; and I also [will be so] toward you."
en.B: Then I said to her, "You must stay with me for many days. You must not prostitute yourself or belong to any man, and I will do the same toward you."
en.R: I told her, "You must live with me for a long time. You must not be unfaithful or be with any man. And I will do the same for you."

es.L: Y le dije: «Muchos días te quedarás [esperando] por mí; no te prostituirás ni serás de ningún hombre; y también yo [lo seré] contigo».
es.B: Luego le dije: «Tendrás que quedarte conmigo muchos días. No te prostituirás ni serás de ningún hombre, y yo haré lo mismo contigo».
es.R: Le dije: «Tienes que vivir conmigo mucho tiempo. No debes ser infiel ni estar con ningún hombre. Y yo haré lo mismo por ti».

fr.L: Et je lui dis : « Pendant beaucoup de jours tu resteras pour moi ; tu ne te prostitueras pas, et tu ne seras pas à un homme ; et moi aussi [je ferai de même] envers toi. »
fr.B: Puis je lui dis : « Tu resteras avec moi pendant longtemps. Tu ne te prostitueras pas et tu n’appartiendras à aucun homme, et j’agirai de même envers toi. »
fr.R: Je lui ai dit : « Tu vas vivre avec moi pendant longtemps. Tu ne dois pas être infidèle ni être avec un homme. Et moi, je ferai de même pour toi. »

ko.L: 그리고 내가 그 여자에게 말했다. "너는 여러 날 동안 나를 위해 머물러 있어야 한다. 음행하지 말고, 어떤 남자에게도 속하지 마라. 나도 너에게 [그렇게 하겠다]."
ko.B: 그리고 나는 그 여자에게 말했다. "당신은 오랫동안 나와 함께 지내야 해요. 음행하지 말고, 어떤 남자의 사람도 되지 마세요. 나도 당신에게 그렇게 하겠어요."
ko.R: 나는 그 여자에게 말했다. "당신은 오랫동안 나와 함께 살아야 해요. 다른 남자와 지내서는 안 되고, 신실하지 않은 일을 해서도 안 돼요. 나도 당신에게 똑같이 하겠어요."

vi.L: Và tôi nói với nàng: "Em sẽ ở lại vì tôi nhiều ngày; em sẽ không làm điếm, và em sẽ không thuộc về người đàn ông nào; và tôi cũng [sẽ như vậy] đối với em."
vi.B: Rồi tôi nói với nàng: "Em phải ở với tôi trong nhiều ngày. Em không được làm điếm hay thuộc về người đàn ông nào, và tôi cũng sẽ giữ như vậy đối với em."
vi.R: Tôi bảo nàng: "Em phải sống với tôi một thời gian dài. Em không được bất trung hay ăn ở với người đàn ông nào. Và tôi cũng sẽ làm như vậy đối với em."

sw.L: Nami nikamwambia, "Utakaa kwa ajili yangu siku nyingi; hutafanya ukahaba, wala hutakuwa wa mwanamume; nami pia [nitakuwa hivyo] kwako."
sw.B: Kisha nilimwambia, "Ni lazima ukae nami siku nyingi. Usifanye ukahaba wala usiwe wa mwanamume yeyote, nami nitafanya vivyo hivyo kwako."
sw.R: Nilimwambia, "Ni lazima uishi nami kwa muda mrefu. Ni lazima uwe mwaminifu, wala usikae na mwanamume yeyote. Nami nitafanya vivyo hivyo kwako."

pt.L: E eu lhe disse: "Por muitos dias você ficará para mim; você não se prostituirá e não será de homem [algum]; e também eu [serei assim] para com você."
pt.B: Então eu lhe disse: "Você ficará comigo por muitos dias. Não se prostituirá nem pertencerá a homem nenhum, e eu farei o mesmo em relação a você."
pt.R: Eu disse a ela: "Você vai morar comigo por muito tempo. Não vai ser infiel nem vai ficar com nenhum homem. E eu vou fazer o mesmo por você."

decisions.choice: and I also toward you: Hosea will keep the same restraint toward her
alternatives: and I will not come to you either
decisions.reason: The last words are only "and also I to you". They most likely mean that Hosea too will wait, keeping himself from relations with her for the same time, as 3:4 pictures Israel living without the things it leaned on. They could also mean "and I will be yours", a promise that he will be faithful to her.

decisions.choice: stay for me many days ... not be for a man: a time of waiting, apart from all lovers
decisions.reason: "Many days" is a long time with no end named. To "be for a man" means to belong to him as a wife or lover (Deuteronomy 24:2). She is to live set apart, belonging to no other man, while she waits.

decisions.choice: prostitute yourself: be unfaithful
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used in 1:2 and 2:7 for unfaithfulness, set for Hosea as "prostitute oneself" at Literal and Balanced and "be unfaithful" at Readable.

decisions.choice: stay with me (B); live with me (R); belong to any man (B); be with any man (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the idioms mean (m2). Readable says "a long time" for "many days". The last clause is kept close to the Hebrew at every level, so that the footnote's question stays open (m1).

decisions.choice: Hosea to his wife: 해라체 with "너" (L); 해요체 with "당신" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's choice for husband and wife, following the Genesis note; Literal keeps the plainer level.

decisions.choice: Hosea to his wife: "em", himself "tôi"
decisions.reason: A husband speaking to his wife says "em"; Hosea keeps "tôi" for himself, as the narrator. Uncertain for a reviewer: a more archaic register might prefer "nàng".

decisions.choice: "nami" with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: Hosea himself speaks in this chapter, so his "nami" (and I) takes no span, unlike the LORD's "nami" in chapters 1-2.

decisions.choice: você (Hosea to his wife)
decisions.reason: Hosea speaks to his wife as one person to another, so Portuguese uses "você" at every level (docs/portuguese-style.md §4); "tu" in chapter 2 is God's address to Israel.

source.text: כִּ֣י׀יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֗ים יֵֽשְׁבוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֵ֥ין מֶ֨לֶךְ֙ וְאֵ֣ין שָׂ֔ר וְאֵ֥ין זֶ֖בַח וְאֵ֣ין מַצֵּבָ֑ה וְאֵ֥ין אֵפ֖וֹד וּתְרָפִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: For days many will stay [the] sons of Israel without king and without prince and without sacrifice and without pillar and without ephod and teraphim.

en.L: For many days the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel will stay with no king and no prince, and no sacrifice and no pillar, and no ephod and teraphim.
en.B: For the people of Israel will live for many days with no king or prince, no sacrifice or sacred pillar, no ephod or household gods.
en.R: In the same way, the people of Israel will live for a long time with no king or ruler, with no sacrifices or sacred stones, and with no ephod or household idols.

es.L: Porque muchos días se quedarán los hijos de Israel sin rey y sin príncipe, y sin sacrificio y sin pilar sagrado, y sin efod y terafines.
es.B: Porque los israelitas vivirán muchos días sin rey ni príncipe, sin sacrificio ni pilar sagrado, sin efod ni ídolos familiares.
es.R: Así también el pueblo de Israel vivirá mucho tiempo sin rey ni gobernante, sin sacrificios ni piedras sagradas, y sin efod ni ídolos de la familia.

fr.L: Car pendant beaucoup de jours les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël resteront sans roi et sans chef, et sans sacrifice et sans stèle, et sans éphod ni téraphim.
fr.B: Car les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} vivront longtemps sans roi ni chef, sans sacrifice ni stèle sacrée, sans éphod ni dieux domestiques.
fr.R: De la même façon, les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} vivront longtemps sans roi ni dirigeant, sans sacrifices ni pierres sacrées, sans éphod ni idoles de la maison.

ko.L: 이스라엘 자손이 여러 날 동안 왕도 없고 고관도 없고, 제사도 없고 기둥도 없고, 에봇과 드라빔도 없이 지낼 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 이스라엘 백성도 오랫동안 왕도 지도자도 없이, 제사도 거룩한 기둥도 없이, 에봇도 드라빔도 없이 살 것이다.
ko.R: 이와 같이 이스라엘 백성도 오랫동안 왕이나 통치자 없이, 제사나 거룩한 돌기둥 없이, 에봇이나 집안 우상 없이 살 것이다.

vi.L: Vì con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên sẽ ở nhiều ngày không có vua, không có thủ lĩnh, không có sinh tế, không có trụ đá, không có ê-phót và thê-ra-phim.
vi.B: Vì dân Y-sơ-ra-ên sẽ sống nhiều ngày không vua, không thủ lĩnh, không sinh tế, không trụ thờ, không ê-phót hay tượng thần gia đình.
vi.R: Cũng vậy, dân Y-sơ-ra-ên sẽ sống một thời gian dài không có vua hay người cai trị, không có sinh tế hay trụ đá thờ, cũng không có ê-phót hay tượng thần trong nhà.

sw.L: Kwa maana siku nyingi wana wa Israeli watakaa bila mfalme na bila mkuu, na bila dhabihu na bila nguzo, na bila efodi na terafimu.
sw.B: Kwa maana watu wa Israeli wataishi siku nyingi bila mfalme wala mkuu, bila dhabihu wala nguzo takatifu, bila efodi wala miungu ya nyumbani.
sw.R: Vivyo hivyo, watu wa Israeli wataishi kwa muda mrefu bila mfalme wala mtawala, bila dhabihu wala mawe ya ibada, na bila efodi wala sanamu za nyumbani.

pt.L: Porque por muitos dias os filhos de Israel ficarão sem rei e sem príncipe, e sem sacrifício e sem coluna, e sem éfode e terafins.
pt.B: Pois os israelitas viverão muitos dias sem rei nem príncipe, sem sacrifício nem coluna sagrada, sem éfode nem ídolos do lar.
pt.R: Do mesmo modo, os israelitas vão viver muito tempo sem rei nem governante, sem sacrifícios nem pedras sagradas, e sem éfode nem ídolos da família.

decisions.choice: for ... will stay: the woman's waiting pictures Israel's
decisions.reason: "For" ties the verse to the one before. The woman "stays" many days (3:3), and Israel "will stay" many days: the same verb. Her time apart is a sign of what Israel will go through.

decisions.choice: pillar, ephod, teraphim: objects of worship and of seeking guidance
decisions.reason: A sacred pillar was a standing stone set up at a shrine (Genesis 28:18), later forbidden because of its use in the worship of other gods (Deuteronomy 16:22; 2 Kings 17:10). An ephod was a priestly garment, used when seeking an answer from God (1 Samuel 23:9-12), and sometimes an object of worship (Judges 8:27; 17:5). Teraphim were household images, used in divination (Genesis 31:19; 1 Samuel 19:13; Ezekiel 21:26).

decisions.choice: without king, prince, sacrifice: Israel deprived of its government and its worship, lawful and unlawful alike
decisions.reason: The list joins things the law allowed (king, sacrifice, ephod) with things it condemned (pillar, teraphim). All are taken away. This describes the exile, when Israel would have neither its rulers nor its shrines.

decisions.choice: sacred pillar (B); sacred stones (R); household gods (B); household idols (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "pillar" and "teraphim". Balanced and Readable say what they were (m2). "Ephod" has no ordinary English equivalent and is kept at every level.

decisions.choice: In the same way
decisions.reason: Readable says how this verse is linked to the last (m1).

decisions.choice: "pilar sagrado"; "efod"; "terafines" (L), "ídolos familiares" (B), "ídolos de la familia" (R)
decisions.reason: The objects of worship and of seeking guidance named as in the published Spanish of Genesis and Judges; Balanced and Readable say what the teraphim were, as the English levels do.

decisions.choice: "chef" (L, B), "dirigeant" (R) for sar
decisions.reason: As the term sheet sets for sarim in the Twelve.

decisions.choice: "기둥" (L), "거룩한 기둥" (B), "거룩한 돌기둥" (R); "에봇"; "드라빔" (L, B), "집안 우상" (R)
decisions.reason: The forms of the published Judges and Kings; R explains the teraphim as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "trụ đá" (L), "trụ thờ" (B), "trụ đá thờ" (R); "thê-ra-phim" (L), "tượng thần gia đình" (B), "tượng thần trong nhà" (R)
decisions.reason: As published: "trụ đá" for the standing stone (1 Kings 14:23), "tượng thần gia đình" and "tượng thần trong nhà" for the teraphim (1 Samuel 15:23; Ezekiel 21:26); Literal keeps the Hebrew word as the English Literal does.

decisions.choice: *sar* "mkuu" (L, B); "mtawala" (R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's word for a ruler under the king; Readable uses the plainer "mtawala" (ruler), as the English Readable says "ruler".

decisions.choice: coluna (L), coluna sagrada (B), pedras sagradas (R); o éfode; terafins (L), ídolos do lar (B), ídolos da família (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "coluna" and "terafins", the Hebrew names; Balanced and Readable say what they were, as the English does (r-en-1). "Éfode" is the word the Old Testament terms set, kept at every level.

source.text: אַחַ֗ר יָשֻׁ֨בוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּבִקְשׁוּ֙ אֶת־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֔ם וְאֵ֖ת דָּוִ֣ד מַלְכָּ֑ם וּפָחֲד֧וּ אֶל־יְהוָ֛ה וְאֶל־טוּב֖וֹ בְּאַחֲרִ֥ית הַיָּמִֽים׃פ

records.literal_gloss: Afterward will return [the] sons of Israel and they will seek Yahweh their God and David their king, and they will come trembling to Yahweh and to his goodness at [the] end of the days.

en.L: Afterward the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel will return, and they will seek {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God and David their king; and they will come trembling to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} goodness at the end of the days.
en.B: Afterward the people of Israel will turn back and seek {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God and David their king. In days to come they will come trembling to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} goodness.
en.R: After that, the people of Israel will come back. They will look for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God and for their king from David's family. In the future they will come to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} trembling with awe, to receive the good things {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gives.

es.L: Después volverán los hijos de Israel y buscarán {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} su Dios y a David su rey; y vendrán temblando {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} bondad al final de los días.
es.B: Después los israelitas se volverán y buscarán {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} su Dios y a David su rey. En los días venideros acudirán temblando {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} bondad.
es.R: Después de eso, el pueblo de Israel regresará. Buscarán {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} su Dios y a su rey de la familia de David. En el futuro vendrán {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} temblando de reverencia, para recibir las cosas buenas que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} da.

fr.L: Après cela, les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël reviendront, et ils chercheront {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu et David leur roi ; et ils viendront en tremblant vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et vers {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} bonté, à la fin des jours.
fr.B: Ensuite les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} reviendront et chercheront {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu et David leur roi. Dans les jours à venir, ils viendront en tremblant vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et vers {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} bonté.
fr.R: Après cela, les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} reviendront. Ils chercheront {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu et leur roi de la famille de David. Plus tard, ils viendront vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} en tremblant de respect, pour recevoir les bonnes choses qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} donne.

ko.L: 그 뒤에 이스라엘 자손이 돌아와서 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}와 그들의 왕 다윗을 찾을 것이다. 그리고 마지막 날들에 그들이 떨면서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께로, 그분의 좋은 것으로 나아올 것이다.
ko.B: 그 뒤에 이스라엘 백성은 돌아와서 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}와 그들의 왕 다윗을 찾을 것이다. 그리고 마지막 날에 그들은 떨며 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 나아와 그분의 선하심을 구할 것이다.
ko.R: 그런 다음에 이스라엘 백성은 돌아올 것이다. 그들은 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찾고, 다윗 집안에서 나올 그들의 왕을 찾을 것이다. 앞으로 그들은 두려움으로 떨며 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 나아올 것이다. 그분께서 주시는 좋은 것을 받으러 올 것이다.

vi.L: Sau đó, con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên sẽ trở lại và tìm kiếm {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ và Đa-vít vua của họ; và họ sẽ run rẩy đến cùng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và cùng sự tốt lành của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong những ngày cuối cùng.
vi.B: Sau đó, dân Y-sơ-ra-ên sẽ quay về tìm kiếm {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ và Đa-vít vua của họ. Trong những ngày sắp tới, họ sẽ run rẩy đến cùng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và đón nhận sự tốt lành của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Sau đó, dân Y-sơ-ra-ên sẽ trở về. Họ sẽ tìm kiếm {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ và vị vua thuộc dòng dõi Đa-vít. Trong tương lai, họ sẽ run rẩy kính sợ đến cùng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} để nhận những điều tốt lành {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ban cho.

sw.L: Baadaye wana wa Israeli watarudi, nao watamtafuta {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao na Daudi mfalme wao; nao watakuja kwa kutetemeka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kwa wema {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} katika siku za mwisho.
sw.B: Baadaye watu wa Israeli watarudi na kumtafuta {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao na Daudi mfalme wao. Katika siku zijazo watamjia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa kutetemeka, na kuujia wema {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.R: Baada ya hayo, watu wa Israeli watarudi. Watamtafuta {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao na mfalme wao kutoka katika jamaa ya Daudi. Katika siku zijazo watamjia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wakitetemeka kwa hofu na heshima, ili wapokee mambo mema anayowapa.

pt.L: Depois os filhos de Israel voltarão e buscarão {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus deles, e Davi, o rei deles; e virão tremendo {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} e à {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} bondade no fim dos dias.
pt.B: Depois os israelitas voltarão e buscarão {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus deles, e Davi, o rei deles. Nos dias que virão, eles se achegarão tremendo {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} e à {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} bondade.
pt.R: Depois disso, os israelitas vão voltar. Eles vão buscar {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus deles, e o seu rei da família de Davi. No futuro eles vão chegar tremendo de reverência diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, para receber as coisas boas que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} dá.

decisions.choice: David their king: a king from David's line
decisions.reason: David had died long before Hosea. As in Jeremiah 30:9 and Ezekiel 34:23-24; 37:24-25, "David" means a king of David's family who will rule as David did. The northern kingdom had broken away from David's house (1 Kings 12:16); its return means coming back under that line, as Judah and Israel are joined under one head in 2:2. Jewish and Christian readers have long seen in this king the Messiah, the anointed son of David.

decisions.choice: return and seek: turn back to the LORD and look to him
decisions.reason: "Return" is the word Hosea uses for repentance, turning back to God (6:1; 14:2). To "seek" the LORD is to turn to him in worship and need (5:15). The same verb was used for the woman seeking her lovers (2:9).

decisions.choice: come trembling: come in awe and eagerness
decisions.reason: The verb usually means to tremble with fear. With "to the LORD" it means coming to him with awe, in eager reverence (compare Micah 7:17; Isaiah 60:5, where the heart "trembles" with joy). The people come shaken but drawn.

decisions.choice: his goodness ... at the end of the days: the good gifts of the LORD in the time to come
decisions.reason: "His goodness" is the LORD's kindness and the good things he gives, like the grain, wine and oil of Jeremiah 31:12, 14. "The end of the days" means the time to come, not necessarily the end of the world (Isaiah 2:2). Deuteronomy 4:30 uses the same words: "in the end of the days you will return to the LORD your God".

decisions.choice: in days to come (B); in the future (R)
decisions.reason: The same wording as Isaiah 2:2 at each level.

decisions.choice: their king from David's family (R); trembling with awe (R); the good things he gives (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says that "David" means a king of David's family, as in Jeremiah 30:9 (m1), and says what the trembling and the goodness mean (m3, m4).

decisions.choice: "volverán" (L); "se volverán" (B); "regresará" (R)
decisions.reason: Shuv of turning back to God is "volver" or "volverse", never "arrepentirse", as the Spanish Jeremiah note sets.

decisions.choice: "마지막 날들에" (L); "마지막 날에" (B); "앞으로" (R)
decisions.reason: *Be'acharit hayyamim*, the phrase the prophets use for the time to come; B uses the common Korean phrase.
